user_clarification: 管理员修改配置查看更多信息；只读用户只查看；问答用户可以回消息问问题。
principles: Roles are server-side capabilities; frontend hiding is insufficient.
Login/logout/auth session writes are permitted for all roles; Viewer cannot create a conversation even if page boot currently does so.
More information means sanitized configuration, node diagnostics and logs; no default plaintext secret disclosure.
Roles control actions; engine/project/conversation scope is checked separately when restricted. Do not assume a full enterprise tenant product is required.
No UI role grants production write/repair rights through MCP automatically.
role_defaults_are_design_choices: Admin includes Chat capabilities; Chat can cancel its own running answer for usability; asset review/publish is a separately granted capability, not implicit config administration.
Default view is shared authorized team/business information; private conversations and operator secrets are not shared solely because users share an engine.
required_negative_tests: Viewer direct HTTP/SSE/WebSocket and bootstrap writes denied
Admin sanitized extended view and scoped config updates succeed
User-supplied profile/node/KB cannot broaden server permissions
Node/Run aggregate filtered; no six-node global leakage via custom endpoints
Trusted-auth username/group cannot be supplied by a direct client to bypass identity
Runtime MCP retains the requesting business scope; UI role cannot turn read-only tools into repair permission
